## Claims
- [source-backed] For \(m\ge1\), source-30 sets \(n=4m\), \(r=s=2m\), \(i=j=m\), obtains \(a=b=m\), and states the count \(\binom{2m}{m}\) only “according to Conjecture 4.10.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955]
- [source-backed] For each type-\(A\) bigrassmannian \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), there is \(w_{r,s,t,n}\) with \(J_v=I_w\) in the coinvariant algebra. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 675-683]
- [proved] Put \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\), \(v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\), and \(w_m=w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\).  Define
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(L)=\min\{|G|:G\subseteq L\text{ homogeneous and }L=A_mG\}.
  \]
  The parameter conditions hold: \(1\le m+1\le2m\le4m\) and \(m+1>2m+2m-4m=0\).  Moreover
  \[
  i=s-t+1=m,\quad j=r-t+1=m,\quad
  a=b=m.
  \]
  In the *same* graded ring \(A_m\),
  \[
  J_{v_m}=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\}
  =\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\not\le w_m\}=I_{w_m}.
  \]
  Hence a homogeneous set generates \(J_{v_m}\) iff it generates \(I_{w_m}\), and therefore
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}).
  \]
  Thus the source-30 reduction preserves generator number when both ideals are considered in \(A_m\).
- [unsupported] No supplied accepted internal result states the required numerical theorem
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\qquad(m\ge1).
  \]
  The supplied source instead labels this count conjectural.

## Strategy
The reduction was proved without changing ambient rings.  It therefore avoids the unjustified inference from a result formulated only in \(\Lambda/I_{2m,2m}\) to one in \(A_m\).

## Gaps
The requested exact internal numerical minimal-generator theorem is absent. Consequently, the displayed preservation equality cannot be combined with an established premise \(\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\). This certificate is **not established**.

## Next
Missing evidence: an accepted theorem or indecomposables certificate explicitly proving \(\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\) for every \(m\ge1\).
